name: Garlic Butter Steak and Mushroom Skillet

fit.reason: 423 cal is within 400-650; 4g carbs is under 35g; no seafood; whole-muscle weigh-and-divide skillet scales cleanly to 14 servings; budget meal-prep dinner.

dupe_check.against_catalog: Not a duplicate. Closest catalog steak entries differ on sauce+starch: honey-garlic-steak-bites-potatoes (sweet honey-garlic sauce over a potato base), beef-mushroom-stir-fry-rice-plate (Asian soy stir-fry over rice), slow-cooker-steak-and-onions-rice and pepper-steak-with-rice (braised/rice-based). This is a savory garlic-herb-butter sear with mushrooms and no starch - only protein+method align, sauce and starch diverge.
dupe_check.against_accepted_slugs: Not a duplicate. low-carb-ground-beef-stroganoff-skillet shares mushrooms but is ground beef in a cream/sour-cream sauce; flank-steak-parmesan-green-beans is a parmesan-crusted steak with green beans; keto-cheeseburger-skillet is ground beef. Different dishes.

cross_protein_watch: Garlic-butter + mushroom skillet is a portable template - the decider should watch other protein pools for a structurally identical 'garlic butter chicken and mushroom skillet' or a pork-chop-and-mushroom-in-garlic-butter version, which would be the same plate with the protein swapped.
evidence: Whole-muscle sirloin/ribeye cubes seared in garlic-herb butter with 8oz mushrooms; published 423 cal / 4g carbs / 38.9g protein at 4 servings, read directly from source page. All ingredients map to the Omaha board (no unmapped).
